verdict.rationale: The only schedule-like capability in the evidence is setting the AI Notetaker to automatically join all Zoom, Teams, and Google Meet meetings (otter-docs-17). Beyond that, there are event-driven automations: auto-syncing to Airtable and S3, a Zapier integration, and the API and webhooks. Recurring workflows would have to be built in external tools like Zapier or through the API, so this is partial at best. Missing for 10: a native scheduler for user-defined recurring jobs, cron- or time-based triggers for workflows or AI Chat reports, documentation of scheduling semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
